context: A teacher walks a teen through a project
purpose: Teach: 悪役/手記/品格/ドラフト/政教/采配/踏襲/俯瞰

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、研究、歴史の悪役、再評価する視点ですね。
lines.en: Sakura, your research on reassessing historical villains—that's quite a perspective.
lines.style: Warm approval, unhurried. Leans forward slightly with genuine interest. Eyes bright. The tone of a teacher who's reading work that made her think.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。当時の手記、複数引用しました。
lines.en: Yes. I cited multiple period memoirs.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Direct eye contact. Not rushed—each word deliberate. The careful precision of someone who's done the work and knows it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 品格ある執筆姿勢、伝わりますね。
lines.en: That dignity in your writing really comes through.
lines.style: Slower pace, nodding slightly. Genuine warmth—not flattery. The sincerity of someone noticing a student's real growth in voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。最初のドラフト、書き直しました。
lines.en: I rewrote the first draft completely.
lines.style: Soft but steady. A hint of vulnerability—she's admitting the work, not hiding it. Slight lift at the end, looking for confirmation she did the right thing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政教関係、慎重に扱いましたね。
lines.en: You handled the political and religious dimensions very thoughtfully.
lines.style: Measured, attentive. Nodding as she speaks. The kind of careful praise that shows she read closely. Specific, not generic.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。リーダーの采配、伝記の中で印象的でした。
lines.en: Yes. The leader's decisions were striking in the biography.
lines.style: Steady delivery. A trace of discovery in the voice—she's still processing what she found. Respectful of the complexity. Engaged but not overreaching.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 過去の慣例を踏襲することの是非、論じましたね。
lines.en: You examined whether following historical precedent was even justified.
lines.style: Contemplative, almost thinking aloud. The gentle challenge of someone inviting a student deeper. Warm but probing—not leading, exploring.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。時代を俯瞰して、章末で総括します。
lines.en: Yes. I step back to see the whole era, then tie it all together at the end.
lines.style: Clear, structured delivery. Growing confidence as she explains her approach. Slight emphasis on the architectural thinking—she knows the shape of what she built.
